subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding the danger of only paying the minimum payment on a debt
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares how long a debt takes to pay off and how much extra it costs when paying only the minimum versus paying more
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a payment strategy to its total cost and payoff time
exercise.abstract: Student explains why paying only the minimum payment on a debt usually costs much more overall

misconception_flags: believes minimum payments pay off a debt just as quickly and cheaply as larger payments
